mockup_description.layout: Drill-down page reached from the flags list, breadcrumb: Présences > Signalements > FLG-2025-0148.
key_elements: Student header: photo, name, class, level, real attendance-rate progress bar, contact info (phone/email)
'Événements déclencheurs' timeline: each triggering event (date, type, 'non justifiée' tag, which session it was) with a 'Voir tous les événements' expand
'Historique de présence (10 derniers jours)' -- compact mini calendar strip, same present/late/absent/upcoming color coding as the main heatmap but condensed to 10 days inline
'Document justificatif lié' -- if an excuse/document is attached to the underlying absence, shown here with status (Accepté) and a 'Voir le document' link
'Notes internes' -- staff notes on this specific student/flag, with author+timestamp, 'Ajouter une note'
'Historique des SMS envoyés' -- every SMS related to this flag, with delivery status (En attente/Livré)

Right sidebar 'Résumé du signalement': Gravité (severity), Assigné à (staff member), Créé le, Statut actuel, 'Action recommandée' (a suggested next step, e.g. 'Entretien avec les parents + Plan de suivi')
Action buttons: Assigner, Marquer résolu, Rouvrir
'Classes & enseignants associés' -- other classes this student is in, each with their own real attendance % for cross-context
interactions: This is a full case file for one at-risk student's flag -- combines timeline, mini-calendar, notes, SMS history, and recommended action into one investigative view

what_matches: Every underlying data source this page needs already exists somewhere in the real app: attendanceFlags (the flag itself), attendance (for the 10-day history and trigger events), attendanceExcuses (linked document), smsMessages (SMS history), student-attendance-heatmap.tsx's data-fetching pattern (already built this session, directly reusable for the mini calendar strip)
what_differs: No detail/drill-down page exists per flag at all -- flags are only ever shown in aggregate or in a flat list, never as an individual case file
No 'notes internes' concept tied to a flag or student in this context -- no schema for it

No 'action recommandée' suggestion logic -- would need simple rule-based text generation (e.g. if type=CONSECUTIVE_ABSENCE and severity=high -> suggest 'Entretien avec les parents'), not a fabricated AI feature, just an if/else on flag type+severity

missing_to_add.item: New route /dashboard/attendance/flags/[id] (or similar) -- assembles data already available across attendanceFlags/attendance/attendanceExcuses/smsMessages into one page
missing_to_add.notes: Mostly a UI-assembly task once 11-director-flags-list.json's list page and its assignment/severity fields exist -- this page is a natural drill-down from it, so should be built together.

missing_to_add.item: Reuse student-attendance-heatmap.tsx's data fetch pattern for the 10-day mini calendar (just a shorter window, different layout)
Internal notes: small new table (flagNotes: id, tenantId, flagId, authorId, body, createdAt) + simple list+add UI
Rule-based 'recommended action' text (no new schema, just a small pure function keyed on flag type + severity)
